reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing getMonthActionCategories / setBudgetsForActionCategories / setMonthAvgForCategories helpers rather than adding new selection code.

duplication.why: The hidden rule with its new flag is applied twice, once in getMonthActionCategories' SQL and again in copyPreviousMonth's inline checks, so the same condition is maintained in two places.

placement.why: Changes stay in budget/actions.ts helpers; toggling a SQL fragment by string interpolation is acceptable but keeps the rule split between SQL and JS.

scope.why: Only the flag on the month-wide actions plus tests; the MonthActionOptions type is a small tidy-up serving the change.

maintainability.why: The flag works through the shared helpers, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own copy of every exclusion (income, hidden, #fixed, template), so each future rule change must again be made twice.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in budget/actions.ts keeps its own inline exclusion checks and gets its own includeHiddenCategories condition instead of using the shared month-action category rule.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated hidden condition is plain (SQL clause vs inline JS check), not reshaped to hide it.
